name: FRED 10-Year Minus 2-Year Treasury Yield Spread
description: Daily yield curve spread between 10-Year and 2-Year US Treasury constant maturities. Used as a primary indicator for macroeconomic recession forecasting.

etl.script: WITH raw_data AS (SELECT UNNEST(observations) AS obs FROM read_json_auto('{{CORS_PROXY}}https://api.stlouisfed.org/fred/series/observations?series_id=T10Y2Y&file_type=json&api_key={{FRED_API_KEY}}')) SELECT CAST(obs.date AS TIMESTAMP) AS date, CAST(NULLIF(obs.value, '.') AS FLOAT32) AS spread FROM raw_data WHERE obs.value != '.';
